event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Small caps led, semis bled.
Core PCE YoY printed 3.3% vs 3.2% fc while Q3 GDP revised to 4.3% vs 3.5% fc, so hot inflation plus hot growth kept XLK at -0.83% and dragged LRCX -5.68% and ORCL -5.13% on the AI sell-off, while small caps and materials absorbed the rotation (IJH +1.19%, XLB +2.07%). VIX at 28.3 with VIXEQ 51.6 is a dispersion regime, not a crash regime.

INDICES — VIX 28.3, VIXY +4.44% (above 23.1 20d MA).
IJH +1.19%, RSP +0.83%, IJR +0.73%, IWM +0.65%, DIA +0.31%, SPY -0.29%, SOXX -0.50%, QQQ -0.65%. Small > large by 1.02pp. Cross-asset: USO +3.29% on a -240 gas draw vs -190 fc and rigs at 470; TLT +0.92%. SPY and QQQ are BELOW their 200-day MAs — CTA sell trigger is live.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SLV 2.2x, GLD 1.6x and IJH 1.4x gaining attention; RSP 1.2x and DIA 1.1x fading. SPY and QQQ vol ratios are not in the feed, so no accumulation/distribution call on the benchmarks. Sector volume: XLI 1.4x, XLK 1.2x gaining; XLU 0.8x, XLE 0.7x, XLC 0.7x ignored. Breadth confirms: 74% advancers, 59% above 50DMA, 54% above 200DMA, up/down volume 1.14, 49 new 60d highs vs 5 lows — broad, not narrow.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLB Materials +2.07%, XLRE Real Estate +0.92%, XLC Comms +0.89%, XLI Industrials +0.83%, XLE Energy +0.74%, XLF Financials +0.71%, XLU Utilities +0.48%, XLP Staples +0.46%, XLY Discretionary -0.20%, XLV Healthcare -0.56%, XLK Technology -0.83%.
Top industries MSOS +4.82%, SILJ +4.35%; bottom DRAM -3.03%, MAGS -1.05%. Flows contradict the tape: XLK +617mm (94p), XLF +538mm (75p), XLP +242mm (83p) in; XLE -1,809mm (0p), XLV -921mm (2p), XLI -590mm (4p) out. Money into tech and financials, out of energy and healthcare. Rotation state: broad risk-on ex-mega-cap, but leaders bleeding flows means short-covering, not conviction.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.54 and IWM 2.73 are heavy protection demand; skew +13.1% on SPY and +13.0% on QQQ is put premium. VIX 28.3 sits above its 23.1 20d MA — elevated fear. VIXEQ 51.6 vs VIX 28.3 is a 23-point gap: high single-stock dispersion, low implied correlation, a stock-picker's tape.

CROSS-ASSET — USO +3.29% on the EIA -240 gas draw and Cushing -53.4, yet JETS fell -0.88%; oil up, airlines down. TLT +0.92% with SLV +0.71% and GLD +0.61% despite 3.3% core PCE says the real-yield move drove it. Next FOMC Dec 9, 2026; Polymarket shows 54% YES on a January 2027 hike (+6pp in 5d) vs 42% no change.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 54.7, Neutral. Movers: LRCX -5.68% (AI sell-off, semis), WPM +5.15% (BofA Buy, target cut to $145), ORCL -5.13%. Momentum extremes: XLP +6.29% 20d best, XLK -18.43% worst. Vol spikes: UTES 3.2x with price +0.17% — heavy volume, no bid. Watch: SOXX -0.50% with +1,564mm (100p) inflow against -59.20% ytd; GLD +0.61% with 1.6x volume and -1,710mm outflow; IWM +0.65% on PCR 2.73 maxpain 269.
